Individually matched (1:1) case-control study

Source: R/calc-obs.R
calculate_case_control_matched.Rd

Uses the discordant-pairs (McNemar/Connor) formulation with the independence-within-pair approximation: pi10 = p1(1-p0), pi01 = p0(1-p1); psi = pi10 + pi01; delta = |pi10 - pi01|; n_pairs = [Za/2 sqrt(psi) + Zb sqrt(psi - delta^2)]^2 / delta^2. Sources: Dupont 1988 (Biometrics 44(4):1157-1168); Schlesselman 1982.

calculate_case_control_matched(p0, OR, alpha, power)
